senses.gloss:
धैर्यं [धीरस्य भावः कर्म वा ष्यञ]
1
[]
Firmness, durability, strength,
constancy, steadiness, stability,
fortitude, courage; धैर्यमवष्टभ्य
Pt. 1; विपदि धैर्यं Bh. 2. 63; so
धैर्यवृत्ति Śi. 9. 59.
--2 Calmness,
composure.
--3 Gravity, patience.
--4
Inflexibility.
--5 Boldness,
forwardness; Me. 40 (धाष्ट्ये Malli.).
